title: Best.
body: I tried like 10 of these apps and Strides is the best one. Helped me to be more productive in work and workout more. I stopped many trackers because I don't need them anymore. I read books, don't eat suggar, sleep well... Thank you Strides makers.
author: Jakub Be.

title: Finally a good app
body:
After 3 days of searching (no kidding) I have finally found this app to track my habits! It allows me to track infinite amount without paying, which is the rarest thing with these apps nowadays.
It is simple and good-looking and my fav part is, that it is working with my Apple Watch=extremely helpfuk. And that can also be a hard find on App Store. 

Thank you for this, dear creator od Strides❤️
author: Alixesa

title: Naj na trhu
body: Skusil som rozne todo appky. Tato je naj.
author: Jakub Be.

title: Buggy crap!
body:
This app a joke!
I just cannot understand how it could be released when basic tracking functionality is not working. App is just adding some duplicated data and also crashes like hell. Also cloud sync between devices is not working. Totally useless crap!
author: lharp

title: Useless
body:
Big bug with week start. It starts with totally wrong day. For example: I set monday as a start day and it starts with sunday..
USELESS!!!
